title: The silent-undo check reads a Drops-lines line above the posting tool's footer
why: Defect, Oct 26 22:55 CDT (build advisor): batch #668 went red because a Drops-lines line in its PR body did not count.
note: lint/check_silent_undo.py reads only the PR body's last paragraph and skips a closing paragraph only when it is the "Generated with [Claude Code]" line. The GitHub posting tool appends a different footer (a --- rule, then "_Generated by [Claude Code](...)_"), so the Drops-lines line above it is never read. Worked around in #671 with a commit trailer. Fix, needs no answer: skip that footer form too, with a test red on main. Port: no; the check lives in claude-settings and installs with it. Placed ahead of c82, after c110 (triage, Oct 27): it turns batches red for nothing.
ask:
# c111: the silent-undo check reads a Drops-lines line above the posting footer

Cloud build thread brief. Build advisor (7), Oct 27, against claude-settings main 6902807 or newer.
claude-settings only. Never rebase onto main after review. Send the green, reviewed head to the
build advisor; never merge.

## Goal

A `Drops-lines: <path> -- <reason>` line in a PR body counts when the GitHub posting tool's
footer follows it. Incident: batch #668 went red for nothing (Oct 26 22:55 CDT).

## Inputs

- lint/check_silent_undo.py, function `allowed`: it skips a closing paragraph only when it is the
  "Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)" line. Also skip the posting
  footer: a `---` rule, then `_Generated by [Claude Code](<any url>)_`, as one paragraph or two.
- Do not widen what counts: only footer paragraphs are skipped; the last real paragraph still rules.

## Proof

Test-author first: cases in lint/test_check_silent_undo.py red on main (the #668 body shape), then
green; a body whose Drops-lines line sits above a non-footer paragraph still does not count.
Quick checks: rule_audit, test_check_glossary, check_mod_versions, hook_catalog --check,
check_silent_undo --strict, shellcheck on changed *.sh, `bin/ste-changed origin/main`, and the touched suites.

## Report

At most 25 lines: draft PR, head, red-run proof, verdicts, reviewer verdict (fresh Sonnet reviewer).
Port: no.
